meta.title: KTRON | Outsourced trimming, deflashing and inspection in Johor
meta.description: Manual post-molding work for injection-molded parts: trimming, deflashing, 10x microscope inspection, sorting and rework. Daily collection within 50 km of Kulai, back in 2–3 working days.
hero.title: Outsourced trimming, deflashing and inspection for injection-molded parts — Johor
hero.sub: Daily collection and return within 50 km of Kulai. 2–3 working days.
why.title: Why outsource your post-molding work
why.1: Keep in-house headcount and labour cost low.
why.2: Pay per piece, not for idle hours.
why.3: Capacity that follows your orders up and down.
why.4: No hiring, training or turnover to manage.
why.close: Lower cost of production, higher profit.
services.title: What we do
services.trimming.name: Trimming & rework
services.trimming.text: Gates, runners, gate marks and burrs removed by hand.
services.deflashing.name: Deflashing
services.deflashing.text: Flash peeled off by hand, from plastic and rubber parts.
services.inspection.name: Microscope inspection
services.inspection.text: Checked under 10x microscopes, with defects counted per lot.
services.sorting.name: Sorting
services.sorting.text: Good parts separated from rejects by eye.
how.title: How it works
how.1: Every day, our drivers collect your lots from the factory.
how.2: A team leader assigns each lot to a skilled home-based worker.
how.3: Each worker finishes the lot at home, then we collect every lot.
how.4: Lots are checked under 10x microscopes, counted and recorded.
how.5: Finished lots come back with their delivery order — in 2–3 working days.
trace.title: Every lot traced, every count recorded
trace.1: Every lot is tracked by its control number, from collection to invoice.
trace.2: Accepted and rejected counts are recorded for every lot.
trace.3: A returned lot is tracked as a new pass of the same lot.
trace.4: Delivery orders and invoices are digital.

faq.title: Questions buyers ask
faq.1.q: How fast do you return lots?
faq.1.a: In 2–3 working days. Urgent lots or your own schedule can be met — tell us when you need them.
faq.2.a: They are counted, kept separate and returned with the lot. Every lot's accepted and rejected counts are on its delivery order.
faq.3.q: What if we send a lot back to you?
faq.3.a: We re-work it as a new pass of the same lot, and both passes stay on the lot's record.
faq.4.a: Per piece handled, accepted and rejected alike, from the delivery orders.
